name: Frost Deshpande
location: Old Harbor, near Lake Shore and Wacker

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African with significant South Asian and Northern European ancestry, complemented by Hispanic/Latin American and Southeast Asian heritage. A striking genetic blend resulting in warm, complex features that reflect his truly global ancestry.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and sturdy, with the weathered muscularity of someone who spent decades on water. Slight thickening at the midsection from age and desk work, but core strength evident in posture.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray, naturally darkening to charcoal at the roots
physical_description.hair_style: Slicked back and trimmed close at the sides, kept practical and functional
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones from his diverse ancestry—sun-darkened and weathered from years of harbor exposure, creating a rich, complex complexion
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, particularly around the eyes and forehead, with facial bone structure reflecting his South Asian and Sub-Saharan heritage—broad nose, defined cheekbones softened by age. Jaw remains sharp despite age. Three-day stubble is his default grooming state. Crow's feet suggest a history of squinting into glare off the water.
distinguishing_marks: Faded anchor tattoo on left forearm, ink bleeding slightly with age
Surgical scar along left collarbone, approximately 8cm, from a dock accident in his thirties
Burn scar on the back of right hand, irregular shape, consistent with coolant splash
Deep vertical crease between eyebrows from decades of concentration and frowning
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Osei-Svanstrom favors invisibility in his work.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with measured deliberation, economical gestures. Stands with weight balanced, feet shoulder-width apart—a harbor man's stance. Hands often rest on table or lap. Direct eye contact. Minimal facial expression; communication relies on tone and word choice rather than animation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear. Heavy canvas work jacket, navy or charcoal, with deep pockets and reinforced seams. Thermal undershirt. Worn denim or canvas trousers with tool loops. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and well-maintained. A simple titanium ring on his left ring finger—no wedding band, just a memorial marker. Occasionally wears a faded GLMZ Harbor Authority cap from a previous life. No visible corpo branding; his clothes are functional, durable, replaceable.
